name: skills
description: A collection of Claude Code plugins: LLM Wiki knowledge base tools and reimpl-tutorial for deep codebase understanding

plugins.name: wiki-tools
plugins.description: Query, update, and ingest knowledge into a personal LLM Wiki. Provides /wiki-query, /wiki-update, /wiki-ingest skills globally.

plugins.name: reimpl-tutorial
plugins.description: Generate 'from zero to expert' tutorials by reimplementing projects in Jupyter notebooks. Includes excalidraw-diagram skill for SVG diagram generation.
